_note: Trade trails (Build 16, docs/23-supercolonies.md § Trade trails). A caravan of carriers walks to another colony and keeps a trail open there; every deliverEveryHours it brings home goods made at the destination, for trailHours, then walks home. Times are hours at world speed 1 (divide by world speed). First-pass numbers for playtest.
_shareNote: Each delivery = share × the destination's own production of that resource per hour (world speed 1) × deliverEveryHours × the distance factor, and never more than the caravan can carry. The destination loses nothing.
_goodsNote: What a trail brings back, by the destination's ground: the weight on each resource's share. Grassland sends a bundle (half a share of each); Sandy Soil sends Foliage (Marz, 5 Nov 2026).
_distanceNote: Longer trails pay more: × (1 + distance / 10,000 × perTenThousand), at most maxFactor. Same patch about ×1.05, the next patch ×1.14, another region ×2.
_partnerNote: On a trail to another player, the host gains too: partnerShare of each delivery's total, in the goods of the sender's ground.
